interpretations.exact_text: A fair, pleasing, somewhat effeminate page, of studious and intent aspect, contemplates a fish rising from a cup to look at him. It is the pictures of the mind taking form.
interpretations.locator: Part III, §2, The Lesser Arcana, Suit of Cups, Page
